rule_0.statement: THE PAD-SPLIT OBSERVATION CHANNELS. The machinery computes, inside gap_of(e,k), the INDIVIDUAL hind-pad gaps gh (heel endpoint) and gm (MP endpoint) and returns only their min -- every machinery read, and every instrument print (the wave-45 [dvfl] band view reads gap_of TWICE at the two endpoints, which are pair-based, so g1==g2 identically), erases the pair to the min: the band's collapsed pair. The wave-46 calibration (cross-checked 12/12 by wave-47) proved the erased rotational DOF is DECIDING: split_abs = 2*(pad_y - gmin) with pad_y = the mean pad point y (the [dvfa] read), and the wave-47 mine measured the LIFT/STALL classes on exactly this quantity (era-rate window (0.275, 0.767) mm/tick). THE CLAIM: (a) the individual-pad-pair channels {g_heel, g_mp}, their per-tick deltas {dg_heel, dg_mp}, and the derived split {split = g_heel - g_mp, split_rate, split_abs = |split|, split_abs_rate} are a REAL two-dimensional-plus-rates rotational read -- provably distinct from the collapsed min channel on real traces (the retrospective's identity rule, first use) -- and (b) projecting them over the wave-47 preserved trace outputs reproduces the measured LIFT/STALL class separation with the windows intact, so the first learned skill's free training labels attach to real channels, and (c) adding them to P3's observation schema is a PURE observation-layer addition: the legacy 64 fields are untouched field-for-field and byte-for-bit on legacy records, and no engine byte moves.

TREATMENT: the reconstructed individual pair from the preserved trace outputs -- g_lo = gmin (the dvfl read), g_hi = 2*pad_y - g_lo (the wave-46 calibration identity: gh+gm = 2*pad_y exactly, since pad radius = plane_model_y_ = 0.004 at every GaitWalker site, shift V{0,0,0}), so split_abs = g_hi - g_lo = 2*(pad_y - gmin), the EXACT wave-46/47 calibrated quantity -- is DISTINCT: (a) the reconstruction identity holds on every reconstructed sample to 1e-9 m; (b) split_abs > kTouch = 1e-5 m (the machinery's own contact-vs-not quantum -- below it the pair is contact-equivalent at the machinery's own scale) on a measured fraction well above zero of the 452 band samples, with max split_abs at the banked lever+mm scale (order 10 mm, since LIFT leverMax alone reaches +16.426 mm); (c) the pair (gmin, split_abs) is not degenerate: split_abs is not constant across samples and the two channels are not the same signal. FIRES if: any reconstruction identity fails, or split_abs <= kTouch on EVERY sample (the channels are a copy), or split_abs is constant. PREDICTED GREEN on the banked numbers; honestly falsifiable if the morphology collapses the pair everywhere outside the lever eras.
